item.name: Cases
List cases for the requested account

request.name: List cases for the requested account

description.content: Returns a paginated list of cases for the requested SRM account. Supports filtering by service provider, customer asset, customer, repair status, repair order number, and event timestamps.

query.description: Filter cases by the service provider's SRM account ID.
Filter cases matching the exact `customer_asset.id`.
Filter cases matching the exact `customer_asset.vin`. Must be exactly 17 characters.
Filter cases matching the exact `customer_asset.serial_number`. Must be between 6 and 17 characters.
Filter cases matching the exact repair order number.
Filter cases matching the exact case reference number.

**Deprecated** — use `filter[repair_status:includes]` instead. Filter cases to only those matching the specified repair status(es). Accepts a comma-separated list of up to 50 statuses. See the `repair_status` endpoint for available values.

**Deprecated** — use `filter[repair_status:excludes]` instead. Filter cases to exclude those matching the specified repair status(es). Accepts a comma-separated list of up to 50 statuses. See the `repair_status` endpoint for available values.
Filter cases to only those matching the specified repair status(es). Accepts a comma-separated list of up to 50 statuses. See the `repair_status` endpoint for available values.
Filter cases to exclude those matching the specified repair status(es). Accepts a comma-separated list of up to 50 statuses. See the `repair_status` endpoint for available values.
Filter cases assigned to the user with the given assignee id (the id segment of the assignee's user URI).
Filter cases assigned to any of the given assignee ids. Accepts a comma-separated list of up to 50 ids.
Filter cases excluding those assigned to any of the given assignee ids. Accepts a comma-separated list of up to 50 ids.
Filter cases started _before_ the specified `ISO 8601` datetime.
Filter cases started _on or before_ the specified `ISO 8601` datetime.
Filter cases started _after_ the specified `ISO 8601` datetime.
Filter cases started _on or after_ the specified `ISO 8601` datetime.
Filter cases by whether a `closed_at` timestamp exists. Use `true` to list only closed cases, or `false` to list only open cases.
Filter cases matching the exact `customer_asset.customer.id`.
Filter cases by the case's primary customer, matching the exact `customer.id` (the customer's UUID). Applies to both local (`customers`) and registered (`registered_customers`) customers.
Filter cases last updated _on or after_ the specified `ISO 8601` datetime.
Filter cases last updated _on or before_ the specified `ISO 8601` datetime.
